name: Therapeutic Phlebotomy (30 min)
description: Quarterly therapeutic phlebotomy session for hereditary hemochromatosis patients. Please bring your most recent lab panel report and a list of current medications. The session takes about 30 minutes. Self-pay flat fee of 75 USD applies if not covered by insurance; the program will bill the patient directly.

name: Therapeutic Phlebotomy Initial Consult (60 min)
description: First-time phlebotomy patients only. Includes a 30-minute consult with the program coordinator.
